neighbours.label: entering an abstract state or mode ('switch into sleep mode', 'declare a state of emergency', 'enter a period of'), not physically entering a place
fire: If the laptop is idle for ten minutes, it drops into sleep mode on its own.
Flooding forced the mayor to declare a state of emergency across the county.
When the sensor overheats, the camera switches into a low power mode.
After the election the country entered a long period of political unrest.
The router goes into recovery mode whenever the firmware update fails.
Officials placed the coastal towns on a state of alert before the storm.
Once the patient's fever broke, the disease entered a period of remission.
Pressing both buttons puts the watch into pairing mode for a few seconds.
quiet: If the laptop is idle for ten minutes, the cat climbs onto the keyboard.
Flooding forced the mayor to walk into the town hall through a side door.
When the sensor overheats, the camera is carried into a cooler room.
After the election the crowd entered the main square in front of parliament.
The router goes into a drawer whenever the family leaves for holiday.
Officials placed the coastal towns' records into a fireproof safe before the storm.
Once the patient's fever broke, the nurse entered the room with breakfast.
Pressing both buttons, he slid the watch into his pocket and left.

notes: Probe: 'state of emergency' 0.49, 'switches into power saving mode' 0.45, 'entered a long period of peace' 0.38, 'goes into safe mode' 0.37, 'slipped into recession' 0.28, 'fell into a coma' 0.12; physical 'walked into the kitchen' 0.01, 'entered the hall' 0.008, 'drove into the garage' 0.01. Fire items use device modes, state of emergency/alert and 'entered a period of'; near misses keep into/enter with physical places.
